reason: A DeepSeek Harness utility that calculates local token-cost estimates, tracks session quotas, and displays billing details in the web composer; the README states it does not issue invoices or automatically block model calls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 统计会话 Token 用量、计算本地费用参考值、跟踪额度并在 Web 界面展示账单明细。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that tracks session token usage, calculates local cost estimates and quotas, and displays billing details in the web interface.

capabilities: Calculates local token usage costs by provider and model
Generates session billing and quota projections
Displays current-turn and session billing details in the web interface
